title: HANGAR (holds the ship)
height: walls 15 m to a flat roof; the big door is in the roof: two leaves slide apart east and west, a 27 x 55 m opening; the whole room is pumped empty of air before it opens
items: SHIP KEEP-OUT 16.4 x 46 (the ship, nose south)
SHIP PADS 7.2 across, one under each pair of legs
SHIP PADS 7.2 across, one under each pair of legs
BRIDGE CRANE on rails along both long walls (overhead, 12 m up)
notes: Owner, 2026-10-07: a hangar that holds the Mars ship (so it must be large); three normal sealing doors into the base and one big outside door the craft goes out through; the room can be pumped empty of air.

The ship is built in code from the owner's locked plan v7 (data/definitions/ship.json) at 46 m (2026-10-18, PRD #10): 16.4 m across its fins, 46 m long, 8.1 m tall on its legs; its legs stand in two pairs, one pad under each. The 12 x 31 m keep-out of 2026-10-07 was the coordinator's estimate of a wedge round the game's old upright ship, and it capped the ship's size; the hangar is now sized to the ship, not the ship to the hangar.

The ship takes off and lands straight up and down on its belly engines (CONTEXT.md virtual stick), so the big door is in the roof: 5 m clear each side of the keep-out box, 4.5 m at the ends. Coordinator's pick, owner may change: a wall door would make the pilot fly out level through it.

Size 32 x 64 m, walls 15 m (2026-10-18, sized to the 46 m ship: about 7.8 m clear past its fin tips each side, 9 m past each end; was 26 x 46 x 13 m, the coordinator's pick for the old keep-out). It stands north of the greenhouse, joined to its north door; the garage joins its east door. The ship stands on its pads nose south, its side ring (the docking hatch and the people airlock) to the west with the mobile stair at it.
